claims: After affirmative confirmation, it copies TAutoCalDM.VECT_AUTOCAL_U8_2 into TAutoCalDM.NUM_ATUOMATCH_EXECUTED, waits 100 ms, then refreshes AutoCal state/UI.
evidence: Delphi semantic index binds TAutoCalDM +0x7C = VECT_AUTOCAL_U8_2 and +0xCC = NUM_ATUOMATCH_EXECUTED.
It calls TAebNumber_GetInt on owner +0x7C and TAebNumber_SetInt on owner +0xCC with the returned value.
